citations.label: Dragos, Three breaches, endless leaks: Your AI supply chain needs canaries: The largest breach involved a couple hundred
citations.excerpt: The largest breach involved a couple hundred of our AWS keys. Each key was sent in exactly one request to one provider, all within a few short windows in late October, and every request we sent during those windows was stolen.

citations.excerpt: Once the attacker had our credentials, they followed a predictable path. First, they tested each key to see if it was live, in some cases within a few hours of our request.

citations.excerpt: We traced this evidence to an inference deployment on a new GPU server. It was serving production traffic without our full production security hardening.
